mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through lower cost of capital for corporate investments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate increase above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates and reduces valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals labor market improvement that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE declines > 0.1pp, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output that correlates with stronger corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through supply chain normalization.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO rises.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden federal funds rate jump above 3.0% within one month signals aggressive monetary tightening that triggers immediate equity sell-offs through heightened risk aversion and reduced liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 1.0pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market that strengthens consumer spending and corporate profit visibility, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and increase in PAYEMS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns through extended earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS rises.
